verifications.claim: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Earth Day occurs annually on April 22. (R1); Earth Day 2024 falls on Monday, April 22. (R3); Earth Day occurs annually on April 22. (R5); Earth Day is celebrated every year on April 22nd. (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Earth Day is annual on April 22.

verifications.claim: The first Earth Day event occurred in 1970.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: started in 1970 (R1); first Earth Day in 1970 (R2); first Earth Day was celebrated in 1970 (R3); first Earth Day on April 22, 1970 (R4); started in 1970 (R5); first Earth Day was celebrated on April 22, 1970 (R6)
verifications.reasoning: All major sources directly confirm first Earth Day in 1970.

verifications.claim: Earth Day is the world's largest civic event.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Earth Day is now recognized as the planet’s largest civic event each year. (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in official Earth Day site as planet's largest civic event.

verifications.claim: Earth Day engages over a billion people.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: uniting more than a billion people worldwide... 1 billion individuals involved (R1); over 1 billion people participating each year (R3); mobilizing over 1 billion people annually (R4); uniting more than a billion people worldwide... 1 billion individuals involved (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state over/ more than 1 billion participants.

verifications.claim: The 2025 Earth Day theme is "Our Power, Our Planet".
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: The official Earth Day 2026 theme is "Our Power, Our Planet." (R1, R5); The theme for Earth Day 2026 is “Our Power, Our Planet,” (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources attribute the theme to 2026, not 2025; no mention of 2025 theme.

verifications.claim: Earth Day was founded in 1970 by U.S. Senator Gaylord Nelson.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Senator Gaylord Nelson (D.-Wis.)... first Earth Day was celebrated on April 22, 1970 (R1); first Earth Day was celebrated in 1970 thanks to Sen. Gaylord Nelson of Wisconsin (R3); Senator Gaylord Nelson (D.-Wis.)... first Earth Day was celebrated on April 22, 1970 (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly credit Senator Gaylord Nelson with founding/first Earth Day in 1970.

verifications.claim: Earth Day was founded after an oil spill in Santa Barbara.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions Santa Barbara oil spill; R1 mentions Cuyahoga River oil slick instead.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 20 million Americans (R1); 20 million Americans (R2); 20 million Americans participated (R3); 20 million Americans (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state 20 million mobilized in 1970 Earth Day.

verifications.claim: The 1970 Earth Day launched the modern environmental movement.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The first Earth Day is credited with launching the modern environmental movement. (R2); credited with launching the modern environmental movement. (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Directly credited in official and supporting sources.
